newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - HFS up on CUC deal.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - HFS up on CUC deal.

text.p: Travel and real-estate franchiser HFS Inc rose in pre-opening trade Wednesday bolstered by its announced $11 billion stock-swap merger with CUC International Inc, traders said.

HFS, whose brands include Ramada Inn and Century 21 Real Estate, was at 59-1/4 after closing Tuesday at 58-1/2. News of its merger with CUC, a big direct marketer, was released after the stock markets' close Tuesday.
CUC was at 25 from its Tuesday close of 26, traders said. The company also reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.17 against $0.13 for the same period a year ago.
Fibreboard Corp was up on news it would be bought by Owens Corning for $55 a share. Fibreboard was bid at 54-1/8 after a Tuesday close of 47-1/2.
"The focus in the pre-opening has been in the deal (merger) stocks," a trader said.
Among other shares, International Business Machines Corp was at 89-3/8 as it prepared to trade on a post-split basis this morning. The stock finished at 178-7/8 Tuesday.
"There may be some action there," the trader said.
Semiconductor maker Micron Technology Inc was steady at 42-5/8 after jumping 4-3/8 Tuesday on positive comments from Merrill Lynch analyst Tom Kurlak.
